HardConstraints.description: Hard filter constraints extracted from user shopping query.

category.description: Canonical product category matching one of the 16 approved catalog categories.
category.title: Category

brand.description: Brand name if explicitly requested (e.g. 'Puma', 'Samsung'). None if unspecified.
brand.title: Brand

min_price.description: Minimum price threshold in specified currency (e.g. 'at least 500' -> 500.0).
min_price.title: Min Price

max_price.description: Maximum price budget ceiling in specified currency (e.g. 'under 2000' -> 2000.0).
max_price.title: Max Price

min_rating.description: Minimum product rating on a 1.0 to 5.0 scale (e.g. 'at least 4 stars' -> 4.0).
min_rating.title: Min Rating

currency.description: Currency code for prices (default: 'INR', or 'USD', 'EUR' if explicitly stated).
currency.title: Currency

HardConstraints.title: HardConstraints

description: Canonical structured representation of a user shopping query.

semantic_query.description: Cleaned, focused search query representing the core product type and essential features, with conversational filler removed.
semantic_query.title: Semantic Query

hard_constraints.description: Structured hard filters (category, brand, price boundaries, rating, currency).

soft_preferences.description: List of qualitative, subjective, or lifestyle preferences (e.g. 'comfortable', 'lightweight', 'durable', 'portable').
soft_preferences.title: Soft Preferences

needs_clarification.description: True if the user query is excessively ambiguous, contradicts itself, or asks for an unsupported category.
needs_clarification.title: Needs Clarification

clarification_reason.description: Explanation of why clarification is required, or null if query is clear.
clarification_reason.title: Clarification Reason
